name.ja: LEGENDBB 武者頑駄無真悪参

description.ja: • 真駆参大将軍の先祖がLEGENDBB化！
description.en: • Ancestors of Shinkokusan Taishogun are now LEGENDBB!

description.ja: • 真悪参が持ち出した頑駄無軍団の秘宝「銀の楯」と「銀狼剣」は新規造形となっており、「銀狼剣」は「銀の楯」に収納することができる！
description.en: • The secret treasures of the Gundam Corps that Shinakusan brought out, the "Silver Shield " and the " Ginro Sword ", are new models, and the " Ginro Sword " can be stored in the " Silver Shield"!

description.ja: • 「三叉の槍」も付属し、幅広い可動範囲で特徴的なポージングが可能！
description.en: • A "three-pronged spear" is also included, allowing for distinctive poses with a wide range of motion!
